items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1978-12-03
items.q: The name of the clarinet, the first one I ever had was a Henry Gunkel.

ctx.x: Well, since you know so much about instruments, I assume, you're in the business. What kind of clarinet was it? Do you have any idea?

Well, the first clarinet, and I think this is an interesting story. I've told him a lot of times, but it's true. The band director came around to the kids and said, I can get you an Albert System clarinet for $36. I can get you an Albert System clarinet, that's the new kind, for $80. And I had the $36 and I didn't have the $80, so I didn't know the difference. I took the Albert and I've always played the same thing. But the name of the clarinet, the first one I ever had was a Henry Gunkel. G-U-N-K-E-L, which came…
So it was a fairly simple thing, fairly close to the can read.
